title: 第25章 梅家姐妹母子拦路第26章 捕盗衙门官差杀
content_zh:
巫教书院坐落在离文安县二十里外的一处矮山上。
这儿既是书院，也是巫教设在文安县的分坛，香火颇旺。
灰白色巨大建筑群依山而建，层层叠叠，山脚下已停了不少各色马车，皆是城中人家来接子弟的。
刘奇将车赶到一处空位停稳，和丫鬟小高一同下了车。对路沉道“路兄，劳烦你看会儿车。我们上去接小姐、搬行李。”
路沉望了望不算陡峭却也不短的山道“我也去吧，行李怕是不轻。”
“不用不用。”刘奇摆手，“就些随身物件，拿得动。路兄歇着便是。”
“行。”
过了一会儿，山道上传来说笑声，几个俊朗、漂亮的少男少女走了下来。
刘奇和小高跟在后面，抱着扛着大堆箱笼包袱，腰都压弯了，步履踉跄。
路沉见状，立刻跳下车辕，快步迎了上去帮忙。
刘奇喘了口气，苦笑道
“可算下来了。多谢路兄。”
他喘匀了气，朝那几个已经走到车旁的少男少女努了努嘴道“这次除了二位小姐，还有她们的三位同窗，也顺道搭咱们的车回县城，还好夫人有先见之明，赁的这辆车够宽敞，不然还真塞不下。”
他一边说着，一边和路沉、小高一起，将那些行李一样样妥善安置到马车后厢和顶架上。
师娘的两个女儿，生得一个比一个俊俏。
姐姐叫梅黛，十四岁，腰细腿长。
妹妹叫梅璎，十三岁，娇小玲珑，脸生得像洋娃娃般精致。
因邓师父是入赘，二女皆从母姓。
同来的三位同窗都是少年郎，模样也齐整。
一个姓张，一个姓雷，都是文安本地富户家的。

另一个姓温，是外地的，看穿着打扮，不像前两位那般阔气，可论起相貌，却是三人中顶拔尖的那个。
三人都是两位小姐的追求者。
几人上了马车，便往县城赶。
因人多载重，拉车的两匹马虽勉强拖得动，却走不快。
路沉问“天黑前能回去不？”
刘奇点头“能，保准天黑前到城门口。”
路沉便不再多话。
马车一路摇摇晃晃，车里几人说说笑笑。
路沉抱着柄刀，眼神警觉地扫过道路两旁。
快过年了，贼偷匪盗也想弄点钱过个好年，不得不防。
他听着车里的谈笑，渐渐觉察出些门道。
这三位少年，与其说是两位小姐的追求者。
倒不如说，三人心思全都在妹妹梅璎身上。
妹妹确实长得比姐姐更漂亮些，声音又娇又脆，像是承了她父亲那副伶俐的口齿。
姐姐梅黛则更像师娘，性子有些冷，话也少，除了身量高挑、腿长些，样样似乎都不如妹妹惹眼。
那三人正卖力地说着俏皮话，句句都往梅璎耳边递，变着法子逗她开心。
姐姐偶尔才插上一句，声音淡淡的。
行至半路，天飘起雪来。
路沉的警惕也提到了最高。
这种天气，这种地界，正是盗匪出没的时辰。

果然，一对母子拦在了路前。
妇人约莫二十出头，裹着半旧的蓝布袄子，怀里搂着个裹在厚斗篷里的孩子，只露出一双黑漆漆的眼睛。
content_en:
The Witchcraft Academy is located on a low mountain twenty miles away from Wen'an County.
This is not only an academy, but also a branch of the shaman religion in Wen'an County, and it is very popular.
Huge gray-white buildings are built on top of the mountain. There are many carriages of various colors parked at the foot of the mountain, all of which are people from the city coming to pick up their children.
Liu Qi drove the car to an open space and parked it, and got out of the car with maid Xiao Gao. He said to Lu Shen, "Brother Lu, could you please watch the car for a while. We'll go up to pick up the lady and carry the luggage."
Lu Shen looked at the mountain road which was not steep but not short either. "I'll go too. I'm afraid my luggage won't be light."
"No, no, no." Liu Qi waved his hand, "Just some personal belongings, you can carry them. Brother Lu, just rest."
"Okay."
After a while, laughter came from the mountain road, and several handsome and beautiful boys and girls came down.
Liu Qi and Xiao Gao followed behind, carrying large piles of boxes and bags, their waists bent and their steps staggering.
When Lu Chen saw this, he immediately jumped out of the carriage and hurried forward to help.
Liu Qi took a breath and smiled bitterly.
"It's settled. Thank you, Brother Lu."
He took a deep breath, pursed his lips and said to the boys and girls who had already walked to the car, "This time, in addition to the two ladies, there are three of their classmates who also took our car back to the county town. Fortunately, my wife had the foresight to rent a car that is spacious enough, otherwise it would not be able to fit in it."
As he spoke, he, Lu Chen and Xiao Gao, carefully placed all the luggage on the back compartment and top rack of the carriage.
The master's wife's two daughters are more beautiful than the other.
My sister's name is Mei Dai, she is fourteen years old, with a thin waist and long legs.
My younger sister is Mei Ying. She is thirteen years old, petite and delicate, with a face as delicate as a doll.
Because Master Deng was the daughter-in-law, both daughters took their mother's surname.
The three classmates who came with me were all young men, and they looked neat.
One is named Zhang and the other is named Lei, both of whom belong to wealthy local families in Wen'an.
The other one, surnamed Wen, is from out of town. Judging from the way he is dressed, he is not as luxurious as the first two, but in terms of appearance, he is the best among the three.
The three of them are suitors of the two young ladies.
Several people got on the carriage and rushed to the county seat.
Due to the large number of people and heavy loads, although the two horses pulling the cart could barely move, they could not move fast.
Lu Chen asked, "Can I go back before dark?"
Liu Qi nodded, "Yes, I'll make sure to get to the city gate before dark."
Lu Chen stopped talking.
The carriage swayed along the way, and several people in the carriage were chatting and laughing.
Lu Chen held the knife in his hand and scanned both sides of the road with alert eyes.
The Chinese New Year is coming soon, and we have to be on guard against thieves and thieves who want to make some money to spend a good New Year.
As he listened to the chatter and laughter in the car, he gradually became aware of some clues.
These three young men were not so much the suitors of the two young ladies.
It would be better to say that the three of them were all focused on their sister Mei Ying.
The younger sister is indeed more beautiful than the older sister, and her voice is delicate and crisp, as if she inherited her father's clever eloquence.
My elder sister, Mei Dai, is more like a mistress, with a cold temperament and few words. Apart from being taller and having longer legs, everything seems to be less eye-catching than her younger sister.
The three people were talking witty words hard, passing every word into Mei Ying's ears, trying different ways to make her happy.
My sister only occasionally interjected, her voice light.
Halfway through the journey, it started to snow.
Lu Chen's vigilance was also raised to the highest level.
This kind of weather and this kind of land is the time when bandits come out.
Sure enough, a mother and son blocked the road.
The woman was in her early twenties, wrapped in a half-worn blue cloth jacket, and in her arms was a child wrapped in a thick cloak, with only a pair of dark eyes exposed.
